question.text: The element that shows greater ability to form <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>pπ</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>pπ</mi></math> multiple bonds is:

solution.text: <math><mi>C</mi></math> forms most stable <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>pπ</mi><mo>-</mo><mi>pπ</mi></math> bonds because it has high bond dissociation energy, more electronegativity, high ionization energy and vacant <math><mi>d</mi><mo>-</mo></math> orbital is unavailable. While others have vacant orbital and low bond dissociation enthalpy and low ionisation enthalpy
